text:
sara: heads-up — kicking off a config-only canary tonight in the evening change window. routing, batching, timeouts, and limits. plan: 10% canary at 02:00 UTC for 20m, escalate to 50% then 100% if green. tagging @mike @julia @kevin for quick signoff

deploy-bot: ✨ scheduled config-canary
- id: cfg-canary-1763664000
- start: 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z
- stages: 10% for 20m -> 50% for 20m -> 100% if green
- rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 1200ms

sara: config payload (config-only change):
```
{
  "routing": {"policy": "latency-aware", "tier_weights": {"ssd": 70, "gpu": 30}, "pin_variant": "v1-fallback"},
  "batching": {"enabled": true, "min_batch": 2, "max_batch": 24, "token_threshold": 800},
  "limits": {"max_inflight": 220, "concurrency_per_model": 8},
  "timeouts_ms": {"generation": 12000, "kv_fetch": 300}
}
```

mike: monitoring OK from infra. i'll watch token-level cost and p95/p99. call rollback on any error spike. pls ping me at first ramp to 50%

julia: are we pinning the model variant? want deterministic fallback so traffic doesn't fan out across variants.

sara: yes — we're not switching model versions. routing.pin_variant is v1-fallback. it's a routing + batching + limits tweak only.

kevin: small perf note: dropping max_batch to 24 (from previous 32) should reduce tail for short prompts. watch kv cache hit-rate — batching changes can nudge cache behavior.

eva: change window approved. public-facing timeout stays 12s. ensure timeouts return graceful body: {"error":"timeout","retryable":true}

mike: my watchlist:
- error_rate_rpc
- request_p95_latency
- token_cost_per_1m
- kv_cache_hit_rate
- deployment_cpu_steal

julia: rollback plan:
1) abort canary (deploy-bot stop cfg-canary-1763664000)
2) restore max_inflight=300 and max_batch=32
3) revert routing policy to global pre-change state
4) postmortem in eng-releases within 48h

sara: i'll be on for the first 40m. quiet window until 05:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: ✅ canary started (10%): cfg-canary-1763664000 — routing to tier weights {ssd:70,gpu:30}

mike: +30s: p95 rose from 1.1s -> 1.3s, error_rate steady at 0.06% — holding. @kevin can you check kv tail?

kevin: kv cache hit-rate dropped ~4% for the canary slice. batching seems to aggregate smaller requests differently. suggest increasing token_threshold to 900 for canary slice only.

sara: agree to try cheap hot-config tweak for canary. avoids full rollback if it resolves.

sara: deploy-bot apply-hot cfg-canary-1763664000 '{"batching":{"token_threshold":900}}'

deploy-bot: applied hot-config to canary. watching for 5m.

mike: 5m after tweak: p95 down to 1.15s, kv hit-rate recovering. no error spike. proceeding to 50% per schedule.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% — scheduled to move to 100% at 02:40Z if no alerts.

kevin: post-deploy action: run a 5m synthetic sweep with short prompts to validate tail latencies.

sara: will run the sweep at 02:45Z and post results. if 15m at 100% is stable, i'll publish release notes and mark the config live. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
